hook_lines: This Pocky is from Japan's Don Quijote

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: "Amaou" = red, round, big, delicious — picked from 1,913 entries in a 2002 Fukuoka contest
Only Fukuoka strawberries meeting the standard can use the name (trademark held by JA Zennoh)
12–13 Brix sweetness is average, but large berries (20g+) are nearly double older varieties
This Pocky uses 8% real Amaou strawberry pulp
Reviews split: mild/low-acid taste vs. some preferring regular strawberry Pocky

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 포키 아마오우 딸기맛을 먹는 리액션 영상. 한 입 베어물고 새콤달콤한 맛에 반응하는 표정 위주 클로즈업, 스틱을 반으로 갈라서 딸기색 크림 단면을 보여주는 장면이 있으면 더 좋음. 10~15초 분량이면 충분.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 日本限定 Pocky 甘王草莓 试吃

quotes.japanese: あまおう苺味のポッキーデカイ!!ビックリするよ。
quotes.translation: This Amaou strawberry Pocky is huge!! You'll be shocked.

quotes.japanese: うすピンクでまろやかなイチゴミルクみたいな味、酸味が少なくってマイルド苺でした
quotes.translation: Pale pink, mellow strawberry-milk flavor — low on tartness, very mild strawberry taste.

quotes.japanese: サクサクのプレッツェル生地は、ビスケットを食べているかのような満足感
quotes.translation: The crisp pretzel stick gives you the satisfaction of eating an actual biscuit.

quotes.japanese: 味は普通のいちごポッキーの方がおいしいかも。。。
quotes.translation: Honestly, the regular strawberry Pocky might taste better...
